title: The Quiet Copy
description: Helix buried a clean-energy prototype. A researcher wants the original files before tomorrow's product demonstration. Find a way into their research vault. Leave the lights on.
objective: Recover the prototype from Research vault.
condition: Below 60% trace: +100 cr / +20 XP. Each optional archive: +100 cr / +15 XP; all three pay XP.
aftermath: An anonymous prototype appears on the open net. Helix's demonstration goes ahead, but the technology is no longer theirs alone.

lore.title: The missing appendix
lore.text: HELIX / INTERNAL REVIEW: The prototype passes every efficiency benchmark. Publication remains suspended until the licensing team establishes which improvements can be removed from the public submission.

lore.title: Lab notebook, 03:17
lore.text: Lark's lab notes: We built the first working cell from scavenged parts. The technician who fixed the cooling loop still takes two buses home. Management says affordable energy would disrupt our market position.

lore.title: A public promise
lore.text: Draft press release: Energy belongs to everyone. Revision note: Legal requests replacement of 'everyone' with 'approved commercial partners'. The original author declined to initial the change.
